# Security policy

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting (Security tab, "Report a vulnerability") and include what is affected and how to reproduce it.

This is a personal project, so there is no response-time guarantee. See [docs/security.md](../docs/security.md) for the known limitations and [docs/deployment.md](../docs/deployment.md) for the production checklist.
